title: Suffixes -ness, -ment · Number Roots · The Solar System
goal: Read, spell, and use words with *-ness* and *-ment*; learn the 9 number roots (a self-evidently transparent, motivating starting point for root study — research/05 §5f); apply both to a solar-system knowledge text.
newToday: suffix *-ness* ("the state/quality of," turns an adjective into a noun) and *-ment* ("the act/result of," turns a verb into a noun); number roots *mono-, uni-, bi-, tri-, quad-, pent-, hex-, oct-, dec-*. Tier-2 words: *enormous*, *distant*.
time: 30–45 min (this session is content-dense — it's fine to run slightly long, or to split the number-roots section into a short extra 10-minute add-on if time is tight). **Materials:** paper, pencil, timer.
